import matplotlib.pyplot as plt; plt.xkcd(); fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8,5)); ax.set_xlim(0,10); ax.set_ylim(0,6); ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')
import matplotlib.patches as mp
ax.add_patch(mp.Rectangle((1,1),7,4,fill=False,lw=2))
ax.add_patch(mp.Rectangle((1,4.6),7,0.4,fill=False,lw=1.5))
ax.text(4.5,5.4,'PV shade roof',ha='center',fontsize=10)
for x in [2,5,7]:
    ax.plot([x,x],[5.0,5.4],'k-')
ax.add_patch(mp.Rectangle((7.6,1.2),0.4,3.0,fill=False,lw=2))
ax.text(7.8,2.5,'door\n+strip',ha='left',fontsize=8)
ax.add_patch(mp.Rectangle((1.6,1.2),2.0,2.6,fill=False,lw=1.5))
ax.text(2.6,3.0,'rack L\ncrates',ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax.add_patch(mp.Rectangle((4.2,1.2),2.0,2.6,fill=False,lw=1.5))
ax.text(5.2,3.0,'rack R\ncrates',ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax.add_patch(mp.Rectangle((1.4,3.9),0.5,0.6,fill=False,lw=1.5))
ax.text(0.3,4.2,'evap hi',fontsize=8)
ax.annotate('',xy=(4.0,3.6),xytext=(1.9,4.1),arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->'))
ax.annotate('',xy=(1.9,1.5),xytext=(4.0,1.5),arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->'))
ax.text(3.0,4.5,'cold fwd',fontsize=8); ax.text(3.0,1.1,'warm return',fontsize=8)
for x in [1.5,4.0,6.5]:
    ax.add_patch(mp.Rectangle((x,0.6),1.0,0.4,fill=False,lw=1.5))
ax.text(4.5,0.25,'ground pads + plinths',ha='center',fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('sketch.png',dpi=150)
